description: This Java source file defines the ICalHandlerFactory class, which implements the RequestHandlerFactory interface. It acts as a WebDAV request handler factory for iCalendar-related HTTP methods, mapping HTTP methods to specific handlers that process WebDAV requests related to iCalendar data.

classes.name: ICalHandlerFactory
classes.description: A factory class implementing RequestHandlerFactory to generate WebDAV request handlers for iCalendar operations, mapping HTTP methods to specific handler methods.

methods.name: ICalHandlerFactory
methods.description: Constructor initializing the handler map with mappings from HTTP methods to handler functions.

methods.name: getHandler
methods.description: Returns the appropriate RequestHandler based on the HTTP method name, or a default invalid method handler if none is matched.

methods.name: handleInvalidMethod
methods.description: Handles unsupported HTTP methods by logging and responding with SC_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED.

methods.name: doNothing
methods.description: Handles simple WebDAV methods that require no action; logs the method and responds with OK.

methods.name: doGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests by invoking ICalWorker's handleGetRequest method.

methods.name: doPut
methods.description: Handles PUT requests by invoking ICalWorker's handlePutRequest method.

methods.name: doPropFind
methods.description: Handles PROPFIND requests by invoking ICalWorker's handlePropFindRequest method.
